span.p:
Part 1 — K-Means / Hierarchical / DBSCAN, all HARD assignments
a purchase fits multiple segments; border points have genuine uncertainty

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§1–2 GMM · p(x) = Σₖ πₖ N(x; μₖ, Σₖ) — universal density estimator
= latent-variable model: z ~ Categorical(π), x | z=k ~ N(μₖ, Σₖ) · generation: sample z then x | z · discovery: infer p(z|x)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§3–4 MLE · maximise log p(X;θ) = Σᵢ log Σ_z p(xᵢ,z;θ)
log OF a sum — intractable, no closed form

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.b: §5 introduce q(z), derive the exact decomposition
p.small: ln p(x;θ) = L(q,θ) + KL(q(z) ‖ p(z|x;θ)) · L is the ELBO, KL always ≥ 0 ⇒ L(q,θ) ≤ ln p(x;θ) for any q

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§6 E-step — minimise the KL gap ⇒ q(z) = p(z|x;θ), the true posterior
for GMM: γ(z_k) = πₖ N(x;θₖ) / Σⱼ πⱼ N(x;θⱼ) [Bayes] ⇒ bound becomes exactly tight at current θ

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§6 M-step — maximise L(q,θ) over θ, q fixed
for GMM: μₖ, Σₖ, πₖ = responsibility-weighted averages ⇒ ln p(x;θ) = L(q,θ) ≤ L(q,θ') ≤ ln p(x;θ') ⇒ true likelihood never decreases (§6.2)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§7 mountain-climbing — E reshapes the bound to touch the peak; M climbs the fixed bound to its peak → new θ
live demo: responsibilities as literal colour blends on boundary points

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §8 PLSA — identical derivation, Gaussian → Multinomial, γ → per-word topic responsibility

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§9 summary — can converge to a local optimum (same caveat as K-Means)
for continuous z the likelihood is completely intractable → VAE = EM's ELBO, generalised to continuous z via a learned approximate posterior + gradient descent
